# Cadence verification library

Checked-in audio fixtures for the `verify-cadence` skill. Two tiny albums,
five tracks, ~2MB total:

- `signal-atlas/` — "Signal Atlas" by Cadence Test Ensemble (3 tracks)
- `field-notes/` — "Field Notes" by Vector Choir (2 tracks)

The audio is synthesized in-repo by
`.agents/skills/verify-cadence/helpers/gen-test-tracks.sh` (ffmpeg `aevalsrc`
chirps + generated cover art, embedded as attached_pic). Every instant of
each track is a unique frequency sweep so PipeWire captures can be aligned
to the decoded file by cross-correlation — do not replace with steady
sines, which alias.
